message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The cause was in `vendor/slugify/index.js`, which deletes every character outside `a-z0-9`, so `è` and `û` were dropped instead of becoming `e` and `u`. That file is marked "do not edit by hand", so I left it alone. I changed `src/blog/slug.js` instead. It now splits accented letters into the base letter plus its accent mark, removes the marks, and then calls slugify.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also uses slugify. I didn't touch it, so product URLs will still drop accented letters unless you want the same fix there.
